license_note: License.txt ships loose in the kit zip (no per-model file); full text embedded here because the placement policy forbids loose .txt surfaces. Retained GLB carries no embedded license.
conversion: GLB references external Textures/colormap.png, so scripts/glb_to_akm.py alone fails with 'No texture found in GLTF material' (it only unpacks embedded images). Staged colormap.png from the kit zip beside the repo unpack triplet in /tmp, then per-node: python3 scripts/picocad_to_akm.py /tmp/race_stage/part_<node>.gltf --merge --output <akm> (pruned with glb_to_akm._prune_gltf_to_node). Geometry preserved exactly; color reduced to 15 snapped palette colors (converter warning, expected for non-picoCAD sources).
bake: python3 scripts/bake_akm_to_static_world_faces.py <part>.akm --mode airframe --up-axis +z --forward-axis +z (per-part, then merged with /tmp/race_stage/merge_race.js). --up-axis +z because picocad_to_akm.py emits Z-up AKMs (AKM=(GLB.x,-GLB.z,GLB.y)). --forward-axis +z VERIFIED from geometry: nose (low, maxH 0.200) at GLB +Z / AKM -Y, spoiler tail (maxH 0.536) at GLB -Z; wheels: front z=+0.64, rear z=-0.88. Body baked --target-size 4.0 (scale 1.5625); wheels baked --target-size 0.9375 for the IDENTICAL uniform scale (their forward span is 0.6). Single output godot_project/assets/world_mesh/race_car_faces.json carries per-part face ranges + pivots + edge tables (face/run indices re-based per part).
